review_scope: Official regulator references only; the Crimson host was not opened.

facts: The notice identifies Pass Investment Managers as a clone.
The notice lists passinvestmentmanagers.com and pass-im.io.
The notice states the clone used details of the authorised PassIM Structured Funds Plc and has no connection to that legitimate fund.
The notice states the clone is not registered to provide virtual-asset services in Ireland.

official_reference_checks.regulator: Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores
facts: The warning identifies Pass Investment Managers and passinvestmentmanagers.com.
The warning states the entity is not authorised to provide the specified investment or crypto-asset services in Spain.

recommended_human_decision.rationale: Two official regulator records identify the exact host. The Central Bank of Ireland explicitly describes the entity as a clone with no connection to the authorised fund.
